description: A switch that passes input a for a set number of clock pulses, then input b for a set number, over and over

params.text: Advances the count by one step each press
Returns the count to the first step of a
Sets how many clock pulses go to input a, a whole number from 0 to 9
Sets how many clock pulses go to input b, a whole number from 0 to 9

inputs.text: A rising edge above 1V advances the count by one step
A rising edge above 1V returns the count to the first step of a
The signal passed on while the count is inside a's run of steps; however many poly channels it carries are carried through
The signal passed on while the count is inside b's run of steps; however many poly channels it carries are carried through
Replaces the steps for a knob while it is patched, one step per volt counted from zero, and held between 0 and 9
Replaces the steps for b knob while it is patched, one step per volt counted from zero, and held between 0 and 9

outputs.text: Carries input a while the count is inside a's run of steps, and input b for the rest of the cycle
Carries input a while the count is inside a's run of steps, and a and b added together for the rest of the cycle

notes: With both step counts at zero the count would have nowhere to go, so the module forces one step onto a
The lamp under a step knob lights while the count is in that input's run of steps

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the steps for a knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.5:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the steps for b knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
